member.name: M:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Printing.GSharpPrinter.RenderBacktickBearingRawString(System.String)
member.summary: ADR-0179 phase 9b: spells a multi-line value that contains a backtick as a parenthesized concatenation of raw-string runs and quoted backtick runs — (a + "" + b) — the shape Go uses for the same hole in its own raw strings.
member.remarks:
The value is split into maximal runs of backtick and non-backtick characters. Every non-backtick run is raw-safe by construction (the caller has already excluded CR and control characters), so it keeps its line structure inside backticks; every backtick run goes into an ordinary double-quoted string, where a backtick is not special. The concatenation is therefore character-for-character the original value — no escape sequence is introduced or removed on either side.
The parentheses are load-bearing: a bare a + b substituted where a literal was expected would re-associate under a surrounding operator and would bind .Length to the last fragment instead of the whole string.
Returns null when the splice does not actually help. A value that is mostly backticks fragments into many short pieces whose longest line beats nothing, and the escaped one-liner is then both shorter and simpler; the decision is made by measuring, not assumed.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.AssignmentExpression
member.summary: An assignment used in VALUE position — target = value yielding the assigned value (ADR-0161 / issue #3350).
member.remarks:
G# has had assignment as a full expression for some time; the belief that it was statement-only (repeated in several cs2gs comments and in issue #3347) was wrong. Emitting this node instead of hoisting the write into a preceding removes the synthetic __spillN temps that carried the assigned value, and fixes the issue #1723 case where an assignment inside a short-circuited operand was DROPPED because no statement seam could legally host it.
The printer parenthesizes the whole form. That is required in an argument list — where a bare name = value warns as the retired named-argument spelling (GS0524, ADR-0161) — and is harmless everywhere else.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.LambdaExpression
member.summary: A lambda (ADR-0074). An expression body renders as the arrow form (x int32) -> expr (an expression-block); a block body renders as the function-literal form func (x int32) RetType { … } (a statement-block), which handles control flow and supplies an explicit for value-returning literals.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.ListPattern
member.summary: A list pattern [1, .., 4] matching an array/slice element-by-element, with at most one element (issue #1889, spec §Pattern matching, ListPattern).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.LiteralExpression
member.summary: A literal expression. The width of a numeric value is conveyed by the type clause, not the literal text (ADR-0115 §B.12).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.LiteralKind
member.summary: The kind of a .

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.LocalDeclarationStatement
member.summary: A local declaration let/var/const name [Type] [= init] (ADR-0115 §B.3).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.LocalFunctionStatement
member.summary: A local function declaration mapped to a G# function-valued let binding (let f = func(params) ret { body }). The C# local function becomes an immutable local holding a function literal (ADR-0115 §B).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.LockStatement
member.summary: A lock target { body } statement (issue #1885). G# has a first-class lock keyword mirroring C#'s mutual-exclusion statement, so the translator emits it directly rather than lowering to the Monitor.Enter/try-finally/Monitor.Exit pattern by hand.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.ManagedReferenceExpression
member.summary: An address intrinsic, not a readonly operator on arbitrary values.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.ManagedReferenceTypeReference
member.summary: A persistent managed-reference type with an optional readonly modifier.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.MemberAccessExpression
member.summary: A member-access expression target.Name.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.MethodDeclaration
member.summary: A function or method (ADR-0024/ADR-0079, ADR-0115 §B.5). When is set the declaration renders as a receiver-clause extension function; issue #3357's explicit form also supports enum and owned extension receivers. Otherwise it is an in-body method on an owned type (or a top-level function). A null renders the bodyless ; form (interface/abstract).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.MultiAssignmentStatement
member.summary: A Go-style multi-target assignment — a, b = x, y (ADR-0015), optionally introducing fresh locals such as a, let b = Pair().
member.remarks:
The native G# rendering of a C# deconstruction assignment into existing variables or storage locations (issues #3353/#3358). ADR-0015 evaluates every target's receiver/index first, then every right-hand value, then writes left-to-right — exactly C#'s deconstruction-assignment order.
A tuple-valued single right-hand expression is supported. Fresh let/var targets may mix with existing storage. Nested target tuples keep recursive lowering because they have no flat assignment form.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.NamedArgumentExpression
member.summary: A canonical named call argument name: value.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.NamedDelegateDeclaration
member.summary: A named delegate declaration delegate Name(params) R; (ADR-0059, ADR-0115 §B.8) — the one place the func keyword stays in a type position.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.NamedTypeReference
member.summary: A named type, optionally generic-instantiated with bracket type arguments (Name[T1, T2]). Width-bearing primitive names (int32, float64, …) are ordinary named types per ADR-0115 §B.12.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.NativeSliceTypeReference
member.summary: A native shared-storage slice, distinct from an exact CLR array.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.NonNullAssertionExpression
member.summary: A postfix non-null assertion operand!! — the G# analogue of the C# null-forgiving operator operand! (spec: "Postfix !! asserts non-null").

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.NotPattern
member.summary: A negated pattern not <pattern> (issue #992, spec §Pattern matching, NotPattern).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.ObjectCreationInitializerExpression
member.summary: A constructor call followed by a property-initializer suffix Target(args) { Name = value, ... } (gsc issue #522). Used for a C# object creation that combines constructor ARGUMENTS with an object initializer (new Foo(x) { Bar = 2 }, issue #1728) — neither the colon struct literal T{Bar: 2} nor a plain construction call has a slot for both a positional constructor call and named member assignments. gsc lowers this suffix form to a synthetic local, the assignments, then a trailing value, so it is legal at any expression position.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.OutArgumentExpression
member.summary: An out-argument declaration passed to a method's out parameter (ADR-0115 §B; sample TryParseOutVar.gs). Renders the inline declaration forms out var x, out let x, or the discard out _. A C# out argument naming a pre-declared variable maps instead to the address-of form &x (a ).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.Parameter
member.summary: A formal parameter name Type, optionally variadic (name ...T), ref-kinded (ref/out/in), or with a default value.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.ParenthesizedExpression
member.summary: A parenthesized expression (inner).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.ParenthesizedPattern
member.summary: A parenthesized pattern ( <pattern> ) used to override combinator precedence (issue #992, spec §Pattern matching).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.PatternTestExpression
member.summary: A native boolean pattern test, value is pattern (ADR-0162 / issue #3351).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.PointerTypeReference
member.summary: A managed-pointer / byref type rendered in the canonical G# prefix form *Element (spec §"Byref/pointer syntax exists as *T", grammar '*' TypeClause '?'?). A C# postfix T* (e.g. byte*, int*, void*) maps to this node; void* (no element type) maps to the faithful void-element pointer *void (ADR-0122 §3 / issue #1033), distinct from the byte pointer *uint8. These appear only on the unsafe Win32 P/Invoke interop surface: the form round-trips through the parser, though the binder later steers callers to ref/out/in (GS0243/GS9006) — the excepted unsafe-interop surface (ADR-0115 §G).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.PropertyAccessor
member.summary: A property accessor (ADR-0051, ADR-0115 §B.11). A bodyless accessor renders as a signature-only contract; a bodied accessor renders its block.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.PropertyDeclaration
member.summary: A property (ADR-0051, ADR-0115 §B.11). With no accessors it is an auto-property prop Name T; otherwise the accessor bodies are rendered.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.PropertyPattern
member.summary: A property pattern case { X: 0, Y: 0 }: matching the subject's members against nested patterns (spec §Pattern matching, PropertyPattern).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.PropertyPatternField
member.summary: One field of a property pattern (X: <pattern>).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.RangeIndexExpression
member.summary: A range start..end, used as an index to slice an array (issue #1889). Either bound may be null for an open range (start.. / ..end / ..).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.RawStatement
member.summary: A raw statement carrying pre-rendered G# text on a single line. An escape hatch for constructs the structured model does not yet cover; the printer emits the text verbatim at the current indentation (no trailing newline).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.Receiver
member.summary: A receiver clause (name Type) for an extension function (ADR-0019/ADR-0079, ADR-0115 §B.5). ADR-0182 (issue #4240) made every receiver clause unconditionally an extension, retiring the issue #3357 func extension (name Type) marker this type used to be able to render — a receiver clause has exactly one printed form now.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.RelationalPattern
member.summary: A relational pattern case < 10: matching against a comparison operator and bound (spec §Pattern matching, RelationalPattern).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.RethrowStatement
member.summary: A rethrow statement (ADR-0176, issue #3897): re-raises the exception the enclosing catch is handling, preserving its original throw site. Distinct from over the catch binder, which resets StackTrace to the throw site.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.ReturnStatement
member.summary: A return statement with an optional value.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.SharedBlock
member.summary: A shared { … } block grouping static members on a class, struct, or interface (ADR-0053/ADR-0089, ADR-0115 §B.11).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.SlicePattern
member.summary: A slice ("rest") subpattern inside a , e.g. the .. in [1, .., 4] — a discard slice, a named capture ..rest binding the middle slice to a new []T variable, or a nested sub-pattern matched against the middle slice (issue #1889, spec §Pattern matching, SlicePattern).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.SpreadElementExpression
member.summary: An ellipsis spread element ...source inside an array or collection initializer.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.StackAllocExpression
member.summary: A stackalloc [count]ElemType expression (gsc issues #1024, #1057, #1041) in G#-style array grammar (the bracketed count first, then the element type). In a safe context this yields a Span<T>; targeting a raw pointer inside an unsafe context yields T*. An optional brace-delimited initializer supplies the element values.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.StaticInitializerBlock
member.summary: A static-initializer block mapped to the canonical G# init { … } form that lives inside a shared { } block (ADR-0140, ADR-0115 §B.11). It carries the body of a non-foldable C# static constructor, lowering into the type's .cctor after static field initializers.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.SwitchArm
member.summary: One arm of a : a pattern (or default when is null) and the result expression it yields.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.SwitchExpression
member.summary: A switch expression switch subject { case <pattern>: <expr> … default: <expr> } (spec §Pattern matching; samples SwitchExpression.gs). Used in expression position (assignable / returnable).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.SwitchStatement
member.summary: A switch statement switch subject { case <pattern> { … } default { … } } used in statement position for side effects (spec §Pattern matching; sample PatternSwitch.gs). Distinct from SwitchExpression, which yields a value.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.SwitchStatementCase
member.summary: One case (or default) arm of a : a pattern and a brace-delimited body. When is null the arm is the default arm.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.ThisExpression
member.summary: The this expression.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.ThrowExpression
member.summary: A C# throw expression used in value position (a ?? throw e, cond ? a : throw e, a switch arm value). G# supports throw-as-expression natively (issue #1153), so it renders as a bare throw e in coalesce-RHS, switch-arm, and ternary positions. In the one position gsc rejects a bare throw — the sole trailing value of an if-expression block branch (GS0277) — it is emitted as a throw STATEMENT followed by a value-producing typed tail: throw e\n default(T).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.ThrowStatement
member.summary: A throw statement.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.TryStatement
member.summary: A try statement with zero or more catch clauses and an optional finally block (ADR-0115 §B; sample Exceptions.gs).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.TupleDeconstructionStatement
member.summary: A tuple / named deconstruction binding let (a, b) = expr (spec §Bindings). Maps a C# deconstructing declaration (var (a, b) = … / (T a, T b) = …).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.TupleLiteralExpression
member.summary: A tuple literal (a, b, c) (spec §Primary expressions, TupleLiteral) — or, with ADR-0172 labels, (line: 1, column: 2). A tuple literal always has at least two elements.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.TupleTypeReference
member.summary: A tuple type rendered as (T1, T2, …) — or, when element names are present, the ADR-0172 name-first form (line int32, column int32). C# value tuples (named or unnamed) map to this form with their element names preserved; access by name stays by-name in the output (ADR-0115 §B.4 as amended by ADR-0172). At least two element types are required.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.TypeDeclaration
member.summary: A class/struct/data-class/data-struct/inline-struct/interface declaration (ADR-0115 §B.4/§B.6/§B.7). The base clause lists the base class first, then interfaces (ADR-0115 §B.6).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.TypeDeclarationKind
member.summary: The aggregate keyword of a (ADR-0029/ADR-0078, ADR-0115 §B.4).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.TypeExpression
member.summary: A type used in expression position — the right operand of an as or is type test (e.g. o as []object, o is string). Renders the canonical G# type clause (slices as []T, generics as T[U]).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.TypeOfExpression
member.summary: A typeof(T) expression (spec §Primary expressions; ADR-0115 §B). The C# typeof(T) maps directly to the identically-spelled G# form, whose argument is a type clause rather than an expression.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.TypeParameter
member.summary: A generic type parameter and its constraints, rendered inside the bracket section (ADR-0020/ADR-0097, ADR-0115 §B.7). The legacy slot carries a single constraint name (any, comparable, or an interface); the flag constraints (class, struct, init()) are repeatable.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.TypePattern
member.summary: A type pattern binding the subject to a designator when it has the given runtime type (spec §Pattern matching, TypePattern). Two spellings exist: the switch form case d is Dog: and the ADR-0166 designation form Dog d / Dog { Name: "Rex" } d, which is the only form a boolean is accepts and the one that preserves C# pattern syntax.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.UnaryExpression
member.summary: A prefix unary operation op operand (e.g. -x, !flag).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.VarPattern
member.summary: A total var name pattern that binds the input at its static type.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.Variance
member.summary: Variance marker on an interface/delegate type parameter (ADR-0021).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.Visibility
member.summary: Accessibility of a declaration. means "emit nothing"; the printer only renders a modifier when the accessibility differs from the canonical default for that position (ADR-0115 §B.10).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.WhileLetStatement
member.summary: A nullable-binding while let loop: while let a = e [, let b = e2]* { … } (ADR-0163).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.WhileStatement
member.summary: A while loop.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.WithExpression
member.summary: A copy/update expression expr with { Field = value, ... } for data structs / data classes (spec §Struct literals; ADR-0115 §B.4). Note the update fields use = (not the : of a composite literal).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Ast.YieldStatement
member.summary: A yield statement inside an iterator func whose return type is sequence[T] (spec §Iterators; sample TupleSequenceIterators.gs). When is non-null the statement is yield <expr> (C# yield return), or the iteration-terminating yield break when is null (issue #3501).

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.Printing.GSharpPrinter
member.summary: Turns a G# emit AST into canonical G# source text following ADR-0115 §B: deterministic ordering, 4-space indentation, K&R braces, visibility only when non-default, in-body vs receiver-clause methods, base-first : clauses, bracket generics, arrow delegate types, ${} interpolation, and @Attr application. The same AST always produces byte-identical text.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.RoundTrip.GSharpRoundTrip
member.summary: Parses canonical G# source with the real G# parser and reports error-severity diagnostics, proving emitted text re-parses.

member.name: T:Cs2Gs.CodeModel.RoundTrip.RoundTripResult
member.summary: The outcome of a call.
